eps.o: Still reeling from the shock of seeing Brooklynn, Darius and the gang encounter a familiar face who may offer answers — or put the group in more danger.
After landing in Italy, Ben leads the way to a safe location. Darius tries to distract Kenji from worrying about Bumpy's egg.
Brooklynn and Santos head to Malta to meet their new partner. Back in Italy, the friends investigate the origins of a mysterious feather.
With a dinosaur on the loose, the Camp Fam crew pulls together to find it. Elsewhere, Santos wonders whether her allies can be trusted.
While Brooklynn looks for friends in Malta's black market, a divided Camp Fam debates whether to track her down — or stay behind.
The gang breaks into groups to pull off a complicated mission. A run-in at the catacombs leaves Brooklynn questioning her goals… and her methods.
It's time to pick a side. Brooklynn turns to old friends to help take Santos down. Meanwhile, a roadblock puts some of the others in serious danger.
While Ben, Darius and Yaz wait for backup, Sammy, Kenji and Gia follow a trail of feathers back toward town. Brooklynn makes an unusual alliance.
Split up and battling separate dangers, the Nublar Six rush to complete their mission and set things right. The trickiest part? Staying alive.
Dinosaur chaos hits the streets of Malta, sending everyone into survival mode. In the end, a deadly standoff has fateful consequences.
